title: Continuation checklist for Storage Fabric development
summary: Continue from qualified source evidence while preserving namespace/capacity/lifecycle/locality authority boundaries, provider-authoritative resume, capability secrecy, node/device admission discipline, and post-commit durable replica repair reconciliation.
invariants: Do not turn physical pathname into object identity.
Do not pool capacity across independent domains for ordinary jobs.
Do not let fast/large/disposable storage count as safety.
Do not allow locality to bypass hard Job-to-Node eligibility.
Do not collapse COPY, VERIFY and COMMIT.
Do not make query-folder unlink equivalent to object destruction.
Keep this documentation sphere separate from executable Storage Fabric packages and update it when durable doctrine or qualified baseline changes.
Do not persist provider bearer tokens or resumable-session capability URIs in generic Storage evidence.
Do not let a stale local checkpoint override authoritative remote resume evidence when reconciliation is available.
Do not treat an endpoint/IP address as stable node identity.
Do not turn a discovered block device into workspace until explicit admission plus a capacity observation exists.
Do not let Storage fleet evidence choose the final Job-to-Node placement winner.
Do not infer DISPOSABLE from TEMPORARY; explicit loss authority is required.
Do not equate OFFLINE with LOST; preserve replica knowledge while excluding unreachable locations from current effective protection.
Commit topology/provider state before reconciling repair; durable repair work re-assesses current policy before copying.
Do not let Instrumentation Mesh observations become Storage safety or mutation authority.
Do not default missing replica policy to one copy; report POLICY_MISSING or use only an explicitly injected estate fallback.
Do not promote Storage dev24 by label while its standards evidence fails and divergent protected fixes remain unproven.
Do not infer Instrumentation Mesh correlation from timestamps, hosts, object similarity or payload content; only producer-supplied evidence may be propagated.
